title: Design: the notice pushes the lines down without moving the columns
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View', 'Customers — Create & Edit', 'Work Orders — Order Parts' and 'Work Order Lines — Create & Edit'.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, on tier A for work orders.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, with a part priced by tier A.
  • Use a desktop browser window exactly 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so the screen matches the design pictures' size.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Take a screenshot of the lines.
  3. Open work order 1's three-dot menu.
  4. Click Change Customer.
  5. Pick customer B.
  6. Click Update Customer.
  7. Take a second screenshot of the lines.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens.

Step 2:

  • The screenshot shows the Lines tab's column headings.

Step 3:

  • The menu lists Change Customer.

Step 4:

  • The dialog opens.

Step 5:

  • Customer B is picked.

Step 6:

  • The notice bar appears above the tabs.

Step 7:

  • Compared with the first screenshot, the column headings keep the same left-right place; the tabs and lines only move down by the notice's height, as pictures 14.2 and 14.8 show.
  • The lines show the same parts and prices.
